intent: New original finished title-free single-cell restaurant entrance; replace wireframe proxy only.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE fresh production game sprite: a finished open restaurant entrance / doorway frame for a polished cozy sushi restaurant, consistent with the already generated dimensional rounded-ink honeywood stools, crates, lanterns and chibi guests and the supplied doodle UI/art catalog. This is a narrow single entrance, not a whole storefront.
Square 1024x1024 image preferred with TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENCY around the silhouette. One self-contained object centered horizontally with generous transparent padding, full base visible near bottom. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, people, sushi, UI, labels or backdrop. Do not include floor, scenery, a wide shop facade or closed door.
The entrance: a stout warm honey-brown wooden frame with two thick rounded posts and a gently bowed top beam, dimensional front/top faces, clean dark brown ink silhouette, soft golden highlights from upper-left, subtle restrained grain, a few tiny dark brass join details. The central opening is clearly OPEN and filled with deep dark harbor teal/navy interior shadow so customers can visibly emerge from it. A very short worn wood sill connects the post bases. No curtains or door leaf blocking passage. Tiny dark shaded inner jambs convey depth. Frame is distinctly taller than it is wide, overall roughly width 0.6 x height 1.0, with clear rectangular walk-through opening.
Camera is front-facing with top faces slightly visible, appropriate to a top-down square-cell game whose objects stand upward from a bottom-center floor anchor. The whole doorway occupies ONE cell horizontally and may extend upward about two cells. Keep bottom threshold flat and horizontal and right/left posts symmetrical. Rich readable dimensional painted game art, chunky rounded forms, thick confident ink, quiet material texture. No photorealistic grunge, no flat vector proxy. Outside the frame is entirely transparent, while the dark opening is intentionally opaque.
